classification.difficultyReason: Calculate curved and total surface areas, then express their ratio as a percentage.

content.prompt:
Express the curved surface area of this cylinder as a percentage of the total surface area.
Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Horizontal closed cylinder with a visible right circular face, a dashed hidden rear semicircle, an axial length dimension below, and a radius marked from the right-face centre to its lower-left rim. Decorative grey shading is omitted.
spec.mathematics: Radius 2.2 cm; axial length 8.5 cm. The radius endpoint lies on the projected circular rim.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements are visible in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Curved surface:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{curved}}&=2\pi rh\\A_{\text{curved}}&=2\pi(2.2)(8.5)\\A_{\text{curved}}&=37.4\pi\text{ cm}^2\approx117.5\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
Total surface:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\A_{\text{total}}&=2\pi(2.2)^2+2\pi(2.2)(8.5)\\A_{\text{total}}&=47.08\pi\text{ cm}^2\approx147.9\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
Use the exact areas to calculate the percentage:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage}&=\frac{37.4\pi}{47.08\pi}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage}&\approx79.44\%\end{align*}$$
